_doc: Cau hinh tran CPU (cores, tuong duong K8s limit) ap LIVE bang `docker update --cpus` (none = --cpus bang so vCPU cua VM; KHONG dung --cpus 0: tren Docker nay 0 = khong doi, da kiem chung). Don vi cot `_cpu` = % cua 1 core, nen C_s = 100 * cores. Telemetry chuan ghi lai gioi han nay o cot raw `container-spec-cpu-quota` (= cores * 100000).
_status: CHI RE2 hop le.
